text: Completed typed pre-deadline signal support end to end. JobRequest and LaunchSpec carry validated catchable signal identity, batch-shell/job-step scope, and 0-65535 lead seconds. Site resolution and every script/registered-task/batch lowering preserve it; sbatch receives exactly one --signal argv value. Opaque, registered-task, typed-batch, and script-batch agent requests use an omitted-when-absent field, and SSH negotiates termination-notices so a peer that cannot honor the semantics is refused locally rather than silently dropping the request. Handshake decoding now ignores unknown feature names to keep negotiation extensible. Worker TaskContext exposes an optional DrainNoticeSource with injected and file adapters, no installed JVM handler, positive polling intervals, and explicit early-delivery/terminal-sequence documentation. Existing no-notice canonical bytes remain unchanged. Full baseline: 529 tests pass; scalafmtCheckAll and githubWorkflowCheck pass on JDK 25. The conforming JDK 17 release gate remains pending because no JDK 17 runtime is installed locally.
